# Lofi Memory

Lofi Memory is a cozy browser space for relaxing games, lofi radio, private journaling, notes, reminders, memories, and calm daily reflection.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/
- Blog: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/blog.html
- About: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/about.html
- Lofi music room: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/lofi-music-room.html
- Lofi radio online: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/lofi-radio-online.html
- Relaxing browser games: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/relaxing-browser-games.html
- Cozy browser games: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/cozy-browser-games.html
- Private online diary: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/private-online-diary.html
- Online diary with lock: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/online-diary-with-lock.html
- Daily journaling app: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/daily-journaling-app.html
- Journal prompts: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/journal-prompts.html
- Mood journal: https://lofimemory.vercel.app/mood-journal.html
